title: Benchmark Specification — TeamFlow Lite
projectDescription: A multi-tenant team task/workflow SaaS. Users create teams, invite members with roles, manage tasks through a status workflow, comment on tasks, and view audit logs.

FR01.name: User Registration and Authentication
FR01.description: Users can register with email and password. Users can log in and receive a JWT. Passwords stored with bcrypt.
acceptanceCriteria: Registration with valid email+password succeeds
Duplicate email registration returns 409
Login with correct credentials returns JWT
Login with wrong password returns 401
Protected endpoints reject missing/invalid/expired JWT with 401

FR02.name: Team/Workspace Management
FR02.description: Authenticated users can create teams. Team creator is owner. Owner can update team name/description and delete team.
acceptanceCriteria: Create team succeeds for authenticated user
Creator is automatically team owner
Only owner can update team name/description
Only owner can delete team
List teams returns teams where user is a member
Deleted teams cascade-delete or soft-delete tasks and comments

FR03.name: Role-Based Access Control
FR03.description: Four roles: owner, admin, member, viewer. Owner manages roles. Permissions enforced server-side on every request.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner can change any member role
Admin can invite members but not change owner role
Member cannot manage roles
Viewer cannot create/edit/delete tasks
Viewer can read tasks and comments
Permissions checked server-side, not just UI-hidden

FR04.name: Task CRUD
FR04.description: Team members with write access can create, read, update, and delete tasks within their team scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Create task with title, description, priority succeeds
Read task returns task with all fields
Update task fields succeeds for authorized users
Delete task succeeds for authorized users
Tasks are scoped to team — cross-team access returns 403
Viewer cannot create/update/delete tasks

FR05.name: Task Status Workflow
FR05.description: Tasks follow a defined workflow: todo → in_progress, in_progress → blocked, in_progress → done, blocked → in_progress. Invalid transitions rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid transitions: todo→in_progress, in_progress→blocked, in_progress→done, blocked→in_progress
Invalid transitions rejected with 400 and meaningful message
Status change logged in audit log
Status change updates timestamp

FR06.name: Task Assignment and Due Dates
FR06.description: Tasks can be assigned to team members. Tasks can have optional due dates. Overdue detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Assign task to team member succeeds
Reassign task updates assignee
Due date is optional, validated as future date on create
Overdue tasks queryable via filter

FR07.name: Comments and Activity Feed
FR07.description: Team members can add comments to tasks. Comments are immutable once posted. Activity feed shows task events.
acceptanceCriteria: Add comment to task succeeds
Comments include author, timestamp, content
Comments cannot be edited or deleted (immutable)
Task detail view shows comments in chronological order
Activity feed includes task creation, status changes, assignments, comments

FR08.name: Audit Log
FR08.description: All important actions are logged: task create/update/delete, status changes, assignments, role changes, team membership changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit log entries include: actor, action, target, timestamp, team context
Audit log is read-only and append-only
Audit log queryable by team, user, action type, date range
Audit log entries are immutable

FR09.name: Notification/Reminder Stub
FR09.description: An endpoint or page section to list overdue tasks assigned to the current user. No email delivery needed.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /tasks/overdue returns tasks past due date and not done
Response scoped to current user assignments
Works without email infrastructure

FR10.name: Search, Filter, and Sort
FR10.description: Tasks can be searched by title, filtered by status/assignee/priority, sorted by due date/priority/created date.
acceptanceCriteria: Search by title substring works
Filter by status returns correct subset
Filter by assignee returns correct subset
Filter by priority returns correct subset
Sort by due_date asc/desc works
Sort by priority works
Sort by created_at works
Combined filters work (status + assignee)

FR11.name: Error Handling and Validation
FR11.description: All API endpoints validate input and return meaningful error responses. All forms show validation errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid JSON body returns 400 with field-level errors
Missing required fields return 400
Invalid enum values return 400 with allowed values
Invalid UUIDs return 404
Unauthenticated requests return 401
Unauthorized requests return 403
Not found resources return 404
Server errors return 500 without stack traces

notifications.description: List overdue tasks for current user

unitTests: Auth service: register, login, token validation
Task service: CRUD operations, status transitions
integrationTests: API endpoints: task CRUD through HTTP
API endpoints: permission boundaries (viewer cannot write)
API endpoints: audit log entries created on actions
Multi-tenant isolation: user A cannot access team B tasks

acceptanceCriteria.runnable: Project starts with a single documented command
acceptanceCriteria.allEndpointsImplemented: All listed API endpoints return appropriate responses
acceptanceCriteria.allPagesExist: All listed UI pages render without crashing
acceptanceCriteria.permissionsEnforced: Server-side permission checks on all write endpoints
acceptanceCriteria.testsPass: All tests pass with meaningful assertions
acceptanceCriteria.documentationComplete: README includes setup, run, test, and API overview
